On x=1 chart the rational target coordinates satisfy u²=s, so the field extension has degree 2, purely inseparable in char2 and separable otherwise. Burnside by affine identity, translations and multiplicative slopes yields the stated exact finite field orbit formula. Independent algebra checked polar gradient p=3,5,7 and enumerated full finite-field subset orbits p=3,5,7,11; universal claims rest on the geometry/group arguments.
